task.prompt:

1. thin uniform ring (hoop) of mass 9 kg and radius 2 m, centre at (5, -3)
2. thin uniform rod of mass 1 kg with ends at (-3, -4) and (2, -1)
3. point mass 3 kg at (-4, 1)
4. thin uniform ring (hoop) of mass 2 kg and radius 2 m, centre at (-5, -2)
5. thin uniform rod of mass 3 kg with ends at (-1, -1) and (1, 1)
6. thin uniform ring (hoop) of mass 5 kg and radius 1 m, centre at (2, 5)
7. thin uniform rectangular plate of mass 2 kg, 4 m × 1 m (sides parallel to the x and y axes), centre at (-5, 4)
8. thin uniform ring (hoop) of mass 6 kg and radius 3 m, centre at (3, 5)
9. thin uniform rectangular plate of mass 1 kg, 3 m × 3 m (sides parallel to the x and y axes), centre at (-2, 3)

11. thin uniform rod of mass 2 kg with ends at (-4, 5) and (3, 2)

25. uniform solid disk of mass 2 kg and radius 2 m, centre at (-3, 1)

27. thin uniform rectangular plate of mass 6 kg, 1 m × 2 m (sides parallel to the x and y axes), centre at (5, -5)
28. thin uniform rod of mass 2 kg with ends at (0, 5) and (-5, 1)
29. thin uniform rectangular plate of mass 3 kg, 2 m × 4 m (sides parallel to the x and y axes), centre at (-1, -4)
30. uniform solid disk of mass 6 kg and radius 3 m, centre at (3, 1)
31. thin uniform rod of mass 1 kg with ends at (1, -2) and (3, -4)
32. thin uniform ring (hoop) of mass 1 kg and radius 2 m, centre at (-4, 5)
33. point mass 5 kg at (-5, 1)
34. thin uniform rod of mass 5 kg with ends at (2, -5) and (-5, 4)
35. thin uniform rectangular plate of mass 9 kg, 2 m × 3 m (sides parallel to the x and y axes), centre at (-4, 2)
36. thin uniform rod of mass 9 kg with ends at (-4, -5) and (-2, -1)
37. thin uniform rod of mass 7 kg with ends at (-2, -2) and (4, 1)
38. uniform solid disk of mass 2 kg and radius 1 m, centre at (-2, 2)
39. thin uniform rod of mass 5 kg with ends at (3, -1) and (2, 4)
40. thin uniform rectangular plate of mass 5 kg, 2 m × 4 m (sides parallel to the x and y axes), centre at (-2, 3)
41. uniform solid disk of mass 3 kg and radius 3 m, centre at (-1, 4)
42. point mass 8 kg at (-1, -5)
43. point mass 9 kg at (-2, 2)
44. thin uniform rectangular plate of mass 3 kg, 1 m × 2 m (sides parallel to the x and y axes), centre at (2, 5)
45. point mass 9 kg at (1, 1)
46. thin uniform rectangular plate of mass 6 kg, 2 m × 3 m (sides parallel to the x and y axes), centre at (-4, -2)
47. thin uniform ring (hoop) of mass 9 kg and radius 2 m, centre at (0, 5)
48. uniform solid disk of mass 9 kg and radius 2 m, centre at (5, -3)
49. point mass 3 kg at (4, 0)
50. thin uniform rectangular plate of mass 1 kg, 1 m × 1 m (sides parallel to the x and y axes), centre at (1, 3)
51. thin uniform rectangular plate of mass 7 kg, 3 m × 1 m (sides parallel to the x and y axes), centre at (3, -4)
52. uniform solid disk of mass 3 kg and radius 3 m, centre at (-4, 5)

Find the moment of inertia of the whole body about the axis perpendicular to the xy-plane through the point (2, 2). Use the standard results about an axis through the centre of mass and perpendicular to the plane: thin rod mL²/12, solid disk mR²/2, thin ring mR², rectangular plate m(a² + b²)/12, together with the parallel-axis theorem. Give the exact value in kg·m² as a reduced fraction p/q (or an integer).

Think it through, then finish with a final line of the form `ANSWER: <your answer>`.
